name: Table 1-11: Climate
_doc: Climate is influenced by Solar Zone. Planets with no atmosphere have predetermined climate: Inner Cauldron = Burning, Outer Reaches = Ice, Primary Biosphere = either. Planets with atmosphere roll here, with -6 if Inner Cauldron or +6 if Outer Reaches.

rows.name: Burning World
rows.description: Fierce heat blankets the Planet. Extreme heat tests Very Hard (-30).

rows.name: Hot World
rows.description: Most of the Planet is dangerously hot. Extreme heat tests range Challenging (+0) to Hard (-20). Sheltered microclimates may have less severe heat.

rows.name: Temperate World
rows.description: Exclusively in or near a system's Primary Biosphere. Can contain extreme heat/cold regions. Temperature resistance tests rarely exceed Difficult (-10).

rows.name: Cold World
rows.description: Most of the Planet is dangerously cold. Extreme cold tests Challenging (+0) to Hard (-20). Sheltered microclimates may have less severe cold.

rows.name: Ice World
rows.description: Frozen pole to pole. Extreme cold tests Very Hard (-30).
